fields.leadIntro: Kha vha dzudzanye fomo ya u fara vharangaphanḓa: vha konisa/dzima masimu, vha swaye zwi tshi ṱoḓea, kana vha engedze masimu avho o khetheaho.
fields.userIntro: Kha vha dzudzanye fomo ya Engedza/Swaya Muraḓo wa Tshigwada: vha kone/vha vha thivhele masimu, vha swaye sa vhane vha ṱoḓea, kana vha engedze masimu avho o khetheaho.
fields.requiredLead: Zwi a ṱoḓea - vhashumisani kha thimu yaṋu vha fanela u ḓadza izwi u itela u ṅwalisa murangaphanḓa
fields.requiredUser: Zwi a ṱoḓea - zwi fanela u ḓadzwa musi hu tshi engedzwa muraḓo wa tshigwada

statuses.intro: Zwiimo zwaṋu zwa vhurangaphanḓa na zwiimo zwiṱuku - zwine muṅwe na muṅwe a zwi humbela (ḓuvha & tshifhinga, masimu a vhurangaphanḓa) musi muthu a tshi ḓivhadza vhurangaphanḓa khazwo.
statuses.deleteConfirm: Phumula tshiimo " {{name}} "? Hezwi a zwi nga ḓo vhuyedzedzwa murahu.
statuses.name: Dzina la tshiimo
statuses.isDefault: Tshiimo tsha mvelele tsha vharangaphanḓa vhaswa
statuses.isBooking: Tshiimo tsha u buka (tsho vhewa nga u buka ho fhelelaho)
statuses.whenMoved: Musi murangaphanḓa a tshi fhiriselwa kha vhuimo uhu .
statuses.fieldsToShow: Tsimu dza u ranga phanḓa dzi ḓo sumbedzwa kha fomo ya u khwinisa
statuses.subStatusesHint: Tshiimo tshiṱuku tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi nga humbela ḓuvha & tshifhinga tshatsho na u engedza masimu atsho - o sumbedzwaho nṱha ha masimu a tshiimo afho nṱha.
statuses.subScheduleLabelPlaceholder: Lebula ya datumu & tshifhinga, tsumbo Founelani murahu kha

notifications.intro: U ḓivhadza vhathu vho teaho musi murangaphanḓa a tshi swika kha vhuimo - nga u ṱavhanya, kana tshifhinga tsho vhewaho phanḓa/nga murahu ha ḓuvha & tshifhinga tsho vhewaho khayo.
notifications.emptyRules: A hu athu vha na nḓivhadzo - engedzani nthihi u itela u tsivhudza thimu yaṋu musi murangaphanḓa a tshi swika kha vhuimo.

jobs.title: Zwo dzudzanywa na u rumelwa
jobs.empty: Ahuna tsho dzudzanywaho kana tsho rumelwaho.

notifications.deleteConfirm: Phumula nḓivhadzo " {{name}} "? Humbudzo dzo lindelaho dzi bvaho khayo dzi a khanselwa.
notifications.testPrompt: Rumelani mulingo wa nḓivhadzo iyi kha inwi muṋe (kha app) ni tshi shumisa ID ifhio ya lead ?
notifications.headersInvalid: Ṱhoho dza Webhook dzi fanela u vha JSON i shumaho , tsumbo {"Thendelo": "Mufari xyz"}
notifications.name: Dzina

notifications.modeAfter: nga murahu ha tshifhinga tsho vhewaho
notifications.noScheduleWarning: Tshiimo itshi a tshi humbeli ḓuvha & tshifhinga, ngauralo nḓivhadzo ya "phanḓa/nga/nga murahu ha tshifhinga tsho vhewaho" a i nga ḓo vhuya ya fhisa.
notifications.noScheduleFix: Kha vha vule Humbelani ḓuvha & tshifhinga tshazwo fhasi ha Zwiimo & Zwiimo Zwiṱuku, kana ni rumele Nga u ṱavhanya.
notifications.everyoneWithRole: Muṅwe na muṅwe a re na mushumo .
notifications.inactiveNever: Vhashumisi vha sa shumi a vha vhuyi vha wana nḓivhadzo, naho vho khethiwa.
notifications.emailHint: Imeili i ya kha ḓiresi ya imeiḽi ya muṱanganedzi muṅwe na muṅwe nahone i ṱoḓa SMTP yo vhewaho kha seva (backend/.env); u swika nga tshenetsho tshifhinga imeiḽi dzi rumelwaho dzi ṅwalwa sa dzo pfukwaho.
